items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: I don't, but he was a big shot there. I don't remember his name though.

ctx.x: Because his brother was the main person in the publishing company; the brother of Irving Mills. He was the big person, president or something.
What was Irving's brother's name? I don't know.
I don't, but he was a big shot there. I don't remember his name though.
